popCulture.title: Description of Greece
popCulture.creator: Pausanias
popCulture.description: Pausanias' Arcadian book — Stymphalus son of Elatus as the eponym who gives his name to the city and lake where Heracles later hunts the Stymphalian birds.

popCulture.title: Bibliotheca
popCulture.creator: Apollodorus
popCulture.description: Apollodorus' Arcadian stemma keeps Stymphalus in Elatus' line — the king whose name sticks to the spring and the bird-haunted lake of the sixth labour.

popCulture.title: Stymphalus (son of Elatus)
popCulture.description: Arcadian king, son of Elatus — eponym of Stymphalus, distinct from the Stymphalian birds that later haunt his lake.
